text:
jin: FYI onboarding OREX finetune (adapter overlay-v2). int4 quant build shows numeric-format drift for invoices (cents dropped).quickpack attached.
marta: ugh. how bad?
jin: float32/int8 fine. int4: 62/100 on invoice-format vs 86/100 float. example: input "Total: $1,200.00" -> model "Total: 1200.0" (loss of .00 or inconsistent comma).
oliver: customer caught it in acceptance tests. blocking for billing flows.
sophia: repro cost? can we isolate to merge vs quant?
jin: repro command: `python tools/eval_quickpack.py --cust orex --adapter overlay-v2 --model base-7b-q4 --quant int4 --tasks invoice-format`. Tokenizer snippet shows comma token id sometimes skipped after merge+quant: `encode("$1,200.00") -> [5021,8,345,13,2201,5]`. After merge+int4 some runs omit the `13`.
marta: likely vocab remap during adapter merge + quant init. two fixes: pin punctuation ids in merge OR fallback postproc (regex). prefer merge fix.
jin: opened PR with targeted pin-list + short int4 warmstart on validation set: https://github.com/redwood/adapter-merges/pull/321
marta: add unit test in quickpack to assert currency regex preserves two decimal places.
jin: done locally; eval-bot ran smoke: "invoice-format int4: 88/100 (was 62/100), small date-format regression noted; full CI running"
oliver: i'll coordinate customer canary validation once CI green. ETA ~6h.
sophia: product: require numeric fidelity SLA for billing routes. no post-hoc hacks.
marta: filing onboarding ticket ONB-788 and adding notes.
jin: will post canary logs here after deploy. :rocket:
